_comment: Agent obfuscation group: Codex CLI with DeepSeek Pro (Sophnet) as the kernel. Same T19 stack and sandbox admission as standalone-llm-obfuscate, but the model iterates with node --check and check.mjs instead of a one-shot prompt dump. Default subjects are corpus/original (the 69-file comparison set).

cli._comment: Unit42-style stacked rewrites. alternative_reimplementation is omitted because it is the main source of silent semantic drift.

selection._comment: Restrict to corpus/original so the agent group is comparable with jsob_corpus_full / vm_corpus_l1 / llm_obfuscated. max_bytes 0 = no size skip; the agent reads original.js from disk in slices.
